decisions.reason: A1 omitted the Countable Choice assumptions of change of variables F2, Sobolev F3 and boundary integration F6. The Statement already assumes Countable Choice, so all proof hypotheses hold. Replaced only A1 with the complete interface and sequence-selection accounting; the cellwise chain rule, density limit, H1_0 closure and row-gradient transformation remain sound.

F1 explicitly cites proof steps 3.1 and 3.2, not just the supplier Statement. Step 3.1 at k=1 gives coefficients (sum of interior support knots)/p; step 3.2 proves B-spline cell derivatives with empty-support zero-denominator terms omitted. These are precisely the identities used in 1.1–1.2. Nonnegative lower-degree partitions and equal endpoint samples also justify the gradient and fully repeated-knot continuity arguments.

The adapter correctly supplies common simplices, neighborhood diffeomorphisms, within-mesh traces and topology, but omitted the separate finite e0/e1 bounds demanded by the geometry-error definition. Added in proof 3.1 the convex-control-hull bound e0 <= max|P^F|+max|P^G|, e1 <= L_F+L_G and both determinant lower constants. These coarse bounds assert no closeness or rate; the original Statement is unchanged.

The admissible-map definition explicitly fixes 0<j_-<=j_+<infinity and 1<=L<infinity, bounds the positive cell determinant between j_- and j_+, and bounds DF and its inverse by L. Thus the named constants in C_F and every pullback hypothesis are inherited by the Statement. The finite common rectangular refinement supplies the conformity partition; positivity and the cellwise quotient rule give the stated (nonsharp) C_W.

F2 omitted the finite face-to-face piecewise C1 cell presentation and closed-cell hypotheses. Restored the full supplier conditions and made step 1.1 rely directly on the stipulated global H1_0 restriction. Finite-dimensionality follows from finite coefficient products; the elasticity supplier then applies with exactly the real domain, shear bounds, finite nonnegative lambda, bounded load and stated constant. The omitted conditions were not needed to establish this already assumed conformity.

The mapped error is only known to lie in L2: the pullback lemma Statement supplies H1 bounds, and its smooth/H1 proof does not explicitly certify the needed arbitrary-L2 interface. Replaced F5 by the nonnegative-measurable cell change-of-variables theorem and finite additivity, and proved the squared physical bound directly for z=(g-Qg)/W. Registered the direct integration dependencies and the Euclidean completed-product identification used by Fubini. No H1 regularity of the error is assumed.

The two open rectangles omit Gamma={1}x(0,1). Replaced the incorrect literal union by D=D_L union Gamma union D_R and defined v=0 on Gamma. Gamma is null, so L2 membership and all distributional integrals are unchanged. The proof gives a fixed nonzero test pairing while the test L2 norm tends to zero, excluding an L2 weak derivative. No item depends on or references this counterexample; its owning examples page uses the same valid trace-jump witness.
